_comment: Rules-of-Engagement scope (feature J). Copy to scope.json in your working dir (or pass --scope <path>) to enforce. Mapache refuses any tool call against an out-of-scope target, a forbidden tool, or a forbidden argument pattern — before it runs. Delete this file (or leave no scope.json) to disable enforcement entirely. NOTE: scanning private/RFC1918 (LAN) ranges is refused by default even with no scope file, unless the range is your target/in 'targets' or you set 'allow_private': true below.
name: ACME external pentest 2026-06
_comment_allow_private: Set to true ONLY for a deliberate internal/LAN engagement, to lift the default guard that refuses scanning private/RFC1918 ranges. Leave false for external/OSINT work.
